reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. The endpoint is NVD-authored annotation presence, not exploitation. All17 reserved source groups have zero positives, so error/calibration remain defined but discrimination and positive-event recall cannot support an enrichment law.
